summary: Read n distinct integers taken from the full span of integers that begins at 0 and ends at n. Exactly one integer in that span is absent. Find the absent integer and write it. The absent integer may be 0, may be n, or may sit strictly between them. The input has no repeats and no integer outside that span.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
